name: What kind of maintenance does a handheld showerhead require?

mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance does a handheld showerhead require?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintaining a handheld showerhead primarily involves regular cleaning to prevent mineral buildup and ensure optimal performance. Periodically wipe down the showerhead and hose with a soft cloth and a mild cleaner. If you notice reduced water flow, soak the showerhead in a solution of vinegar and water to dissolve mineral deposits. Check the hose and connections for any signs of wear or leaks, and replace washers or O-rings as needed. Regular maintenance extends the life of the unit and maintains water pressure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Regular cleaning with a mild cleaner and occasional descaling with vinegar prevent mineral buildup and maintain performance.
